speaker: mathilda
text: You didn't turn around.

speaker: ophelia
text: I wanted to. Every step.

speaker: ophelia
text: You lied about the car.

speaker: mathilda
text: I didn't know what else would get you this far. You only ever walk toward a way out.

speaker: mathilda
text: This is where it happened. Do you remember which of us went through?

speaker: ophelia
text: You did. I pulled you out.

speaker: mathilda
text: That's how you tell it.

speaker: ophelia
text: I don't. I've never known.

speaker: mathilda
text: One of us held very still, and one of us pulled. And after that you never let me go anywhere again.

speaker: ophelia
text: I was scared you'd go through again.

speaker: ophelia
text: The card in the cellar said one cup.

speaker: mathilda
text: You only ever set out one for yourself. Mine you set out for me.

speaker: ophelia
text: I found your pack. Two cups.

speaker: mathilda
text: I packed for both of us. I always do. You just never came.

speaker: ophelia
text: You wrote on the post that it used my name.

speaker: mathilda
text: It did. And I answered. That's how I knew it wasn't lying.

speaker: mathilda
text: So you said go, then.

speaker: ophelia
text: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry I said it.

speaker: ophelia
text: You were already going.

speaker: mathilda
text: I was standing at the door, waiting for you to stop me.

speaker: mathilda
text: I know. I heard you. Every time you called, I heard you.

speaker: ophelia
text: Then why didn't you answer?

speaker: mathilda
text: I did. You kept hearing yourself.

speaker: ophelia
text: It's my handwriting on your pages.

speaker: mathilda
text: Then you've been writing to yourself the whole time. Read it back sometime. Out loud.

speaker: ophelia
text: The torn page said the prints just stop.

speaker: mathilda
text: They stop where you stopped looking.

speaker: mathilda
text: I'm not the one who went out into the storm, Ophelia. I'm the part of you that wanted to.

speaker: ophelia
text: Then what's under the sheet?

speaker: mathilda
text: A coat, buttoned to the throat. Nobody was ever in it.

speaker: ophelia
text: I don't care what you are. Come home.

speaker: mathilda
text: Ask me properly. Not "come home." Ask.

speaker: ophelia
text: Walk back with me. Beside me. Not behind.

speaker: mathilda
text: Okay.

speaker: ophelia
text: Stay out here if you need to. I'll keep the lantern lit.

speaker: mathilda
text: Then I'll always know where you are.

speaker: ophelia
text: I need a minute.

speaker: mathilda
text: The ice will hold. Take it.

speaker: mathilda
text: Still here. Still holding still.

speaker: ophelia
text: You left the door open for me. The page by the bed.

speaker: mathilda
text: For one of us. I never could decide which one needed rescuing.
